mapper.sql: a.id, a.course_id, a.type, a.name, a.description, a.prompt, a.purpose, a.tags::text AS tags_json, a.publication_status, a.upload_status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, i.original_file_name, i.content_type, i.byte_size, i.storage_key, i.pending_original_file_name, i.pending_content_type, i.pending_storage_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.assets (id, course_id, type, name, description, prompt, purpose, tags, publication_status, upload_status) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{description}, #{prompt}, #{purpose}, CAST(#{tagsJson} AS jsonb), #{publicationStatus}, #{uploadStatus})
INSERT INTO edu.image_assets (asset_id, original_file_name, content_type, byte_size, storage_key) VALUES (#{id}, #{originalFileName}, #{contentType}, #{byteSize}, #{storageKey})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu.assets a JOIN edu.image_assets i ON i.asset_id = a.id WHERE a.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.type = 'IMAGE' ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC
SELECT FROM edu.assets a JOIN edu.image_assets i ON i.asset_id = a.id WHERE a.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.id = #{assetId} AND a.type = 'IMAGE'
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.assets SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, prompt = #{prompt}, purpose = #{purpose}, tags = CAST(#{tagsJson} AS jsonb), publication_status = #{publicationStatus}, upload_status = #{uploadStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND course_id = #{courseId}

UPDATE edu.image_assets SET original_file_name = #{originalFileName}, content_type = #{contentType}, byte_size = #{byteSize}, storage_key = #{storageKey}, pending_original_file_name = #{pendingOriginalFileName}, pending_content_type = #{pendingContentType}, pending_storage_key = #{pendingStorageKey} WHERE asset_id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edu.assets WHERE id = #{assetId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
